name: imap-mcp
description: Generic IMAP to MCP server on Cloudflare Workers: one Worker that syncs a mailbox into D1 and serves it over MCP.

bindings.IMAP_HOST: Your mailbox's IMAP hostname. For iCloud: imap.mail.me.com
bindings.IMAP_USER: Your mailbox user. For iCloud this is the LOCAL PART ONLY of the address -- "ada", not "ada@icloud.com".
bindings.IMAP_PASSWORD: An app-specific password for that mailbox, NOT your account password. iCloud: appleid.apple.com -> Sign-In and Security -> App-Specific Passwords.
bindings.MCP_API_KEY: The bearer token your MCP clients will present to this server. Generate a random one: openssl rand -base64 32
